terms: fal.ai model output; speridlabs/idol/max lists commercial use as supported. Generated for this project; no third-party likeness, brand or logo requested.

steps.prompt: A round golden-yellow cartoon bird toy figure standing on two small orange feet, plump body shading to bright orange at the bottom with a cream belly patch, short orange beak, big round white eyes with orange irises under fierce eyebrows, a tall crest of four flame-shaped golden and orange feathers swept back on the head like a flame, short flame-shaped orange tail feathers, smooth rounded sides with NO wings at all, no arms, nothing on the sides of the body. Photograph of a real hand-painted wooden toy: carved and lathe-turned hardwood with smooth satin enamel paint, visible wood grain and soft brush strokes, chunky rounded toy proportions, tilt-shift macro product photography, soft warm daylight. Single isolated object, the entire object in frame with margin, centered, three-quarter front view from slightly above, even soft studio lighting, no cast shadow, plain light-grey seamless background. No text, no logos, no lettering, no numbers, no brand marks, no emblems anywhere on the object.
